review_candidates.title: Cloud Software Engineer I
review_candidates.description: Please read all the requirements for the Cloud Software Engineer I position listed below Cover Letter Requirement : A cover letter must be submitted along with your resume. Applications submitted without a cover letter will not be considered . Note: If applying through Indeed and unable to upload a cover letter, please email your cover letter to employment@earthscope.org after submitting your application. Application Limit : This posting will close after the first 100 qualified applications have been received. Work Authorization : EarthScope Consortium Inc. is not able to sponsor employment visas for this position. Work Location Eligibility : Applicants must be authorized to work and physically reside within the 50 United States . EarthScope is only able to employ individuals working within these states. Job Title: Cloud Software Engineer I Reports to: Engineering Manager II Travel Requirements: up to 10% Employment/FLSA Status: Full-Time/Exempt Remote Eligible: Yes, National, United States Salary Range: $93,150 - $112,815 (depending on experience, skills, and qualifications relative to the job requirements) Benefits and Perks: Comprehensive Medical Plan Covering Medical, Dental, Vision Short Term and Long-Term Disability Coverage 403(b) Plan with Company Match Life Insurance PTO, Paid Holidays Position Summary The Cloud Software Engineer I is responsible for designing, implementing, testing, and documenting software and systems in cloud computing environments. The incumbent will work under direct supervision to apply well-proven techniques with little technical risk. This is an entry level position. Details Of Responsibilities General Essential Job Duties: Work with project teams and individually to design, develop, implement, and support cloud-based software systems. Test and document software components, automating tasks whenever possible. Work with project teams and individually to improve and debug existing functionality. Participate in joint analysis and design activities with other staff to define directions, standards, timelines, and identification of key technologies for evolving moderately complex software systems. Participate in platform maintenance activities and component upgrades. Leverage cloud-native design principles and vendor-specific managed services in software solutions. May support commercialization efforts as needed. Other duties may be assigned as necessary for the successful operation of the business. Leadership and Supervisory Responsibilities: This position does not have supervisory responsibility. Has frequent communication with project leads for instruction and guidance, and direct supervision by a functional manager. Interacts effectively and efficiently with EarthScope staff, community and partnering organizations. Foster a professional culture through the use of strong interpersonal skills, verbal, and written communications. Communicate clearly and effectively with other team members to ensure tasks are completed on time and with best practices. Qualifications Minimum Education & Experience Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems or related STEM field at time of hire AND Six (6) months of practical software development experience, either as part of an educational project, internship, or equivalent. OR At least two (2) years of practical software development experience. Assignment-specific Position Summary The Cloud Software Engineer I will support the development, maintenance, testing, and modernization of software applications and workflows used by EarthScope's Portable Programs, with a primary focus on Data Preparation and Capture operations. The position will contribute to software supporting geophysical data ingestion, processing, quality control, metadata management, and archival delivery. Working collaboratively with software engineers, Data Preparation staff, and scientific domain experts, the incumbent will help maintain existing production systems, improve workflow reliability, and support the transition to modernized and cloud-based data services. Assignment-specific Essential Duties: Develop, maintain, test, and document software applications and tools supporting Portable Program data ingestion, processing, quality control, and archival workflows. Support maintenance and development of the PASSOFT software suite and related tools, including data2passcal/data2epic, SOHViewer, lemi2seed, phoenix2seed, and associated processing applications. Contribute to the design, development, testing, and implementation of next-generation nodal data processing workflows, including the transition from PH5-based processing to future AWS-hosted, cloud-based data ingestion and processing workflows, with an emphasis on automation, efficiency, and long-term maintainability. Support development, modernization, and integration of Portable Program data management applications and databases, including SDB, eQuip, and related systems. Assist with the development, testing, and deployment of AWS-based data processing, quality control, and batch data submission workflows. Investigate and resolve software issues affecting operational data processing, metadata management, and archival delivery. Collaborate with Data Preparation and Capture staff, software engineers, and other technical teams and external users, including the PI community, to identify operational requirements, troubleshoot issues, and implement sustainable software solutions. Contribute to automated testing, software packaging, deployment, documentation, and knowledge sharing to improve software maintainability and operational continuity. Support the integration of emerging Portable Program instrumentation, data types, and associated processing workflows. Other duties may be assigned as necessary for the successful operation of the business. Assignment-specific Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability for the position: Ability to develop, test, troubleshoot, and maintain software applications supporting scientific data processing and management workflows, including existing and legacy codebases. Familiarity with one additional programming language such as Java, Typescript, C++ or an equivalent programming language and ability to write modular, reusable code. Familiarity with Linux-based development environments, command-line tools, databases, data formats, and file-based processing workflows. Ability to collaborate with scientific and technical staff, external users, and the Principal Investigator (PI) community to understand requirements, troubleshoot issues, and translate operational needs into software solutions. Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation, including software functionality, development activities, and troubleshooting procedures. Familiarity with a collaborative software repository system such as GitHub or GitLab. Assignment-specific Preferred Skills: Experience or familiarity with scientific software development and data processing, particularly in geophysics, geodesy, or related Earth science disciplines. Experience with software repository processes such as MRs, code reviews, pull requests, and CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with scientific data formats and processing tools, such as SEED, HDF5, RINEX, or related technologies. Experience with Python-based scientific computing, data processing libraries, and software packaging tools such as conda or conda-forge. Familiarity with AWS-based scientific data workflows, including cloud-based processing, data management, and archival systems. Preferred Skills: An understanding of earth sciences, earth science data, and the earth science community. Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability for the position: Familiarity with Agile practices (continuous integration, test driven development, pair programming, etc.). Capability to work on projects using Python, Java, Typescript, C++ or an equivalent programming language and to write modular, reusable code. Ability to learn new technologies, programming languages, and design patterns; and the ability to incorporate those concepts into projects. Understanding of the coding life cycle within git including design, development, testing, peer review, and automated deployment. Disciplined approach to quality engineering via automated testing (Pyunit, JUnit, etc.) Ability to work with version control tools like Git, ability to package software that can be deployed with CI/CD. Familiarity with software containerization (Docker). Ability to develop within cloud computing environments, especially AWS. Familiarity with service-oriented architecture and RESTful web services development. Familiarity with database design, both SQL and NoSQL, database services, and scripting database queries. Familiarity with at least one of the following specializations: Understanding service-based design, ability to develop and maintain RESTful web services using tools like FastAPI, Spring, Django Ability to write front-end applications using tools like Angular, React, or equivalent and integrate those applications with back-end services. Ability to write Infrastructure as Code using such tools as AWS CDK or Terraform, and an understanding CI/CD pipeline using GitLab CI, Jenkins, or equivalent. Knowledge of data streaming and stream processing using tools such as Kafka, Flink, or equivalent. Other Requirements: Appropriate availability consistent with EarthScope established practices and norms; hours may exceed 40 hours per week, particularly when traveling. Environment Physical Setting and Requirements: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT: Occasionally/Frequently/Continually required to stand Frequently required to sit Frequently required to utilize hand and finger dexterity Frequently required to talk or hear While performing the duties of this job, the noise level in the work environment is usually quiet The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds Specific vision abilities required by this job include: Close vision and the ability to adjust focus. Specialized equipment, machines, or vehicles used: Ability to see computer screen with detailed screen menu in low lighting conditions Acknowledgment This job description is designed to provide a general overview of the requirements of the job and does not entail a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities that will be required. The EarthScope Consortium reserves the right to add to, remove or modify this job description at any time. This includes the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed. The EarthScope Consortium also reserves the right to release or eliminate this position at any time. Equal Opportunity It is the policy of EarthScope Consortium not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or any employee based on the criteria outlined in Title VI and Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. Reasonable accommodation may be requested to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the Essential Functions. EarthScope’s Mission : EarthScope Consortium is a consortium dedicated to supporting transformative global geophysical research and education. To Apply : Applicants may apply by going to the EarthScope Consortium Career Center: https://www.earthscope.org/careers/ Applicants MUST be authorized to work permanently in the United States. EarthScope Consortium participates in E-Verify.

Strengthen delivery quality through reviews of supplier pipelines, infrastructure and deployment evidence. Guide decisions on environment strategy, automation, reliability, security, lead time and cost. Improve release traceability, artifact integrity, recovery and operational readiness. Advance reproducible delivery through controlled promotion, versioning and policy gates. Skills And Capabilities Must-haves Degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering or a related discipline. Enterprise software engineering experience in cloud-native and distributed systems. Hands-on enterprise AI engineering and AI release lifecycle experience. Deep knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, release engineering and SRE practices. Experience with isolated environments, promotion controls and configuration versioning. Knowledge of model, prompt, data, retrieval, tool, asset and runtime traceability. Experience with artifact integrity, secrets management, policy gates and regression evidence. Knowledge of AI workload observability, availability, latency, cost, SLIs and SLOs. Proven technical leadership through standards, reviews, supplier assurance and remediation. Strong communication, cross-team influence, mentoring and documentation skills. Nice-to-have Advanced study in AI/ML, distributed systems or cloud/platform engineering. Rewards and Benefits Permanent local contract with a competitive salary plus Tabaqueira employee benefits including: Life and Health insurance Employee Pension Plan 26 holiday days National and international growth opportunities Diverse and international work environment For Poland: In this position, you will earn no less than 327660 PLN gross per year. 34555

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer (Product)
review_candidates.description: Crimson Academies is a global education organisation delivering high-quality, live, real-time learning to ambitious students around the world. With thousands of students joining us from more than 90 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures. The Role At Crimson Academies, thousands of bright young minds in more than 90 countries log in every day to platforms built by our own team. We're building the online school we wish existed, and we move fast. Really fast. If you enjoy a thriving environment with a great team, fast product-feedback loop, close proximity to users, and most of all high autonomy to shape features and get them into the hands of those users: we'd love to hear from you. What do we need? We're looking for software engineers to sit close to our users and problems to shape and build the future of our educational products. As a product engineer you'll have strong software engineering fundamentals (particularly on the web front-end), and the natural intuition and delivery skills to get features in front of users; owning the full software delivery loop end-to-end. You're curious, you question how things have always been done, and you bring fresh ideas to the table. You excel in high-autonomy/high-ownership environments. You turn complex requirements into software that feels simple and users love. You'll join a small remote-first engineering team where your ideas ship quickly, and you'll see their impact on real students and teachers around the world. What You'll Do Take ownership of hard technical problems end to end, from framing through to shipping, monitoring, and iterating Build LLM powered features, deployed to the cloud Contribute to a culture of quality; test-driving your own work and the work of your peers. You ensure that when work is done, it doesn't go backwards Leverage agentic coding to build complex software features that span the entire tech-stack and cross many systems and services Work side by side with your peers in product & engineering to constantly improve our software development culture, particularly in regards to emerging practices around agentic coding Talk to our people (students, teachers, staff, and stakeholders) and use what you learn to ensure we're always building the right thing What You'll Bring 3+ years of hands-on experience working across the entire stack but with focus on the front-end: React, Tailwind, TypeScript, Node, Tanstack, and Postgres. Experience with Go a bonus but not required Excitement and a demonstrable track record of shipping software to production environments that you're proud of Sound engineering fundamentals. You leverage agentic coding, but you can review and understand what coding models produce, reason about software application design, and code by hand where necessary Clear, honest communication and empathy driven team-first instincts. You back your teammates, and deliver what you've committed to. Personal commitment to Crimson Academies' standards: unlocking potential together, rethinking and rebuilding, and raising the bar to compound impact The Details This is a full-time, permanent role. We're a fully remote engineering team based in New Zealand, with optional office days for Auckland-based candidates. This role is only open to candidates with existing New Zealand working rights. If you want to be deployed close to the product, ship quickly and see your work make an impact on the lives of students and families, and work in an AI driven engineering team that still holds solid engineering principles in high regard: please get in touch.

review_candidates.description: Dematic is looking for a talented Software Support Engineer to provide remote, second level customer support with Dematic's Global Software Organization. The work schedule for this opening is rotating 12-hour night shifts, four nights on and four nights off. The employee will work closely with customers, first level technicians, and software/technical engineers to resolve customer issues. The employee may participate in emergency situations requiring on-site support. Ideal candidates will possess knowledge of multiple programming languages, operating systems, databases, and networking. The employee can be based anywhere in the United States (remote/work from home position). We offer: What We Offer: Career Development Competitive Compensation and Benefits Pay Transparency Global Opportunities Learn More Here: https://www.dematic.com/en-us/about/careers/what-we-offer Dematic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $65,000 - $140,000 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills. Tasks and Qualifications: This is What you Will Do in This Role: Assist project and technical engineers in integration of new systems Assist technical and development personnel in application quality testing Work on site to install, commission, and test installation of material handling solutions Provide specified technical support to customers on-site Troubleshoot server hardware, Ethernet networks and other peripherals such as printer Review Sales and Estimating Functional Specifications documentation Travel approximately 20% of the time to different customer locations and Dematic locations in the United States Participate in an on-call rotation during non-business hours What We Are Looking For: Bachelor's Degree (Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field) At least 2 years' experience in software, network and/or hardware engineering positions (preferably in Material Handling Industry) Experience with Oracle databases Experience with MS SQL Database Experience with Windows operating systems
